findings: 9 walk-forward windows (one per calendar year from 2018 to 2026, 2017 reserved as the initial training-only period). Same configuration (G01-v0.1-FROZEN-BASELINE) used in every window -- no re-optimization between windows.

records.methodology: Calendar-period aggregation (month/quarter/year) plus inter-trade gap and best-single-period concentration.
findings: Longest gap with zero trades: 12 days.
The single best month accounts for 10.7% of all positive monthly profit -- reported as a fact, no pass/fail threshold applied.

records.methodology: Per-regime trade grouping using Trade.marketRegime, when present.
findings: No trades in this Evidence carry a marketRegime tag -- regime coverage cannot be computed for this Evidence. No regime classifier exists yet in this research program (see design doc section 11); this is reported honestly, not fabricated.

records.methodology: Distribution statistics beyond total return: median, expectancy, streaks, top-decile concentration.
findings: Median trade P&L: -19.16. Expectancy per trade: -2.179.
Best 10% of winning trades account for 17.7% of total gross profit -- a concentration fact, not a pass/fail judgment.

records.methodology: Baseline-vs-perturbed-configuration comparison (framework only -- see design doc section 12).
findings: Not executed for this Evidence: real parameter-sensitivity analysis requires new backtests with perturbed EA inputs, which this sprint's guardrails explicitly forbid ('Do not optimize G01. Do not change G01 parameters.'). The framework itself is built and verified against synthetic configurations (see test_validation_engine.py Test H). Deferred to a future sprint that explicitly authorizes new runs.
